I replied to you in the #canyon-team thread. The written records don't support what you overheard, so I suggested not recording it yet.

- **Rollout name:** Moss's public Sierra cheat sheet, last updated Sep 28, calls the Dreyness Brewing Co. rollout "Quartz", not Osprey.
- **Main contact:** the same sheet names Ulrike Lorcroft, their Receiving Operations Lead, as the customer's lead for the rollout.
- **No match:** I found nothing linking an Osprey rollout or anyone called Linnea Halvorsen to Dreyness. My search was keyword-only, so it could have missed something worded differently. There is a Linnea Vesshaw, who leads the Sierra team internally, which might explain the name.
- **Who can confirm:** Dreyness is a Sierra team account owned by Florian Lorthorpe, so I pointed you to him.
